name: Simone Zulu
office: Palmdale School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Simone Zulu Diol has represented Trustee Area 5 on the Palmdale School District Board since November 2018 and is the board clerk. She is a retired district preschool teacher and former president of the Palmdale Elementary Teachers Association. She was a Head Start teacher and site director. In 2019, she completed the California School Boards Association’s Masters in Governance program.

items.text: Zulu Diol supports holistic, multicultural education that involves families. In 2022, as board president, she wrote that she focuses on early-childhood and multicultural education and supported adding student board members. She was named 2026 Board Member of the Year by the California Association of African-American Superintendents and Administrators.
